name: Won Deal to ClickUp Client Onboarding

parameters.content:
## 1. Check the request
Only requests with the shared secret get in. The deal is read from the generic JSON or the GoHighLevel shape and checked. Bad requests get a clear answer and stop.

## 2. No duplicates
Each deal is remembered by its id. A deal that already has a list is never set up twice: this checks its own memory first, then looks in ClickUp for a list with the deal id in its name. A run that only needs to finish its setup or its email skips ahead on the middle line.

## 3. Create the list from the template
ClickUp answers when the template is fully applied. If that call times out or fails, the list is looked up again before anything is called a failure, so a slow template never becomes two lists. Only when no list exists is the call tried once more.

## 4. Kickoff tasks and custom fields
Template tasks with a matching name are adjusted, missing ones are created. One change at a time, so a retry can never create a task twice. Package, start date and deal value go into the custom fields.

## 5. Welcome email and Slack
The welcome email goes out through Postmark only when the whole setup worked. Slack gets the ClickUp link, or says exactly what exists and what failed. Failed runs end in a Stop node, which starts the error workflow.
